subject: Arcadia pilot — extension request & packaging options
messages:
From: Sam Zhou <sam.zhou@arcadia.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@arcadia.io
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Arcadia pilot – extension request & packaging options

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team has been running the Redwood pilot (15-seat, 30-day timebox) and we’re seeing good signal on extraction accuracy and latency at our target token loads. We have two asks as we head into week 3:  

1) We need an additional 30 days to finish the integration tests (our infra team hit a blocker around SSO). Can Redwood extend the pilot for +30 days?
2) We want to explore converting any unused days at the end of the extended pilot into credits we can apply to a committed package if we buydedicated capacity. If that’s possible, please outline the conversion rate and any expiration.

Budget is constrained for Arcadia this quarter. If there’s a short-term concession (credit, discount, or a small professional services accelerator), that would make a conversion to a Dedicated SLA much more likely. Also, procurement needs an updated PO template and confirmation that audit logs and SSO artifacts are available for the extended window (they’re copied here).

I attached the Arcadia_PO_Template.pdf we prefer for procurement.

Can you share options by EOD tomorrow? We’re trying to align internal approvals.

Best,
Sam
Sam Zhou
Lead, Platform Integrations
Arcadia Labs

Attachment: Arcadia_PO_Template.pdf (application/pdf, 68 KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Zhou <sam.zhou@arcadia.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arcadia pilot – extension request & packaging options

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear note and the PO template. Glad the pilot is proving valuable. We can definitely propose a couple of pragmatic paths that balance runway for you with predictable economics for Arcadia. High level options below; I’ll loop in Finance and Pricing (Kimberly) for final sign-off.

Option A — 30-day extension (no commit):
- Price: one-time extension fee equal to 25% of original pilot seat cost (applied as invoice).
- Conversion: any unused days convert to token credits at 60% of list (credits expire 6 months).
- Includes: audit logs for the extension window, SSO docs, and a 4-hour engineering accelerator to unblock SSO issues.

Option B — 30-day extension + conversion LOI:
- If Arcadia signs a non-binding LOI to evaluate purchase of Dedicated capacity within 60 days: 15% one-time credit on extension fee (effectively a 10% net discount) + convert unused days at 80% of list into credits (12 months validity).
- Includes: 8-hour accelerator and prioritized onboarding queue.

Operational notes:
- We can escrow the conversion credits in our billing system and only apply them post-contract signature.
- We’ll provide audit logs and SSO artifacts in the production-like staging environment during the extended period; engineering will coordinate with your SRE lead.

I attached a quick extension_option_sheet.xlsx that lays out the math. Kimberly — can you confirm whether Finance needs a minimum threshold for authorizing the LOI concession? If so, we can present a single number for Sam/Procurement to approve quickly.

Sam — happy to jump on a 20-minute call to walk through the options.

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: extension_option_sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 12 KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Arcadia pilot – extension request & packaging options

Vivek / Marissa — quick internal note on approval levers.

I reviewed the sheet. Finance will approve an LOI concession but we should be explicit about two guardrails: 1) conversion credits in Option B must be escrowed and tied to a contract signature window (60 days max), 2) credits provided as a conversion should be capped at the equivalent of 45% of the extended-seat value to protect gross margin.

My recommended counters:
- If Arcadia signs LOI within 60 days: 20% one-time concession on extension fee (not 15%) as a closing incentive, convert unused days at 75% of list, credits valid 9 months.
- If Arcadia declines LOI: authorize up to 15% credit on extension fee; convert unused days at 60% of list, credits valid 6 months.

I can approve the 15% path today. Anything above that (20% path) requires RevOps/Finance sign-off; I’ll ping Finance if you want to push the LOI incentive. Also, ensure we document the escrow handling in the billing note — no automatic refunds, only credit issuance post-signature.

Marissa — can you confirm that operations can produce the staging audit logs and SSO artifacts during the extra 30 days? We should provide a one-page checklist for Arcadia’s procurement.

Kimberly
VP, Pricing & Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Zhou <sam.zhou@arcadia.io>

Vivek / Kimberly — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear options. We’ll accept the non-LOI extension under the 15% credit path so we can get the SSO work prioritized immediately; procurement has approved the payment schedule on that basis. Please: 1) send an updated SOW/addendum that reflects the 30-day extension, the 15% concession, and the conversion rule (60% list, credits valid 6 months) and 2) provide the DocuSign link so we can route to procurement.

Also, attaching our signed NDA (Signed_NDA.pdf) per procurement. If we see strong deployment results by end of extended window we’re prepared to move faster on a Dedicated commitment.

Sam
